claims.text: NASA ordered Boeing's Starliner to return uncrewed from its first crewed flight because the spacecraft experienced five reaction-control system (RCS) thruster anomalies during the docking approach on 2024-06-05 [Source: ev-1].

When NASA announced this decision on 2024-8-24, it cited that these thruster anomalies could not be guaranteed safe for the deorbit burn because the thrusters could not be ground-tested in their specific flight condition [Source: ev-1].
